text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! I was awesome out there,
wasn't I?
Super strong and super cool,
right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hello?! Don't you have anything to say
to me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hello?! Don't you have anything to say
to me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Right?! I knew I could do it too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I need mooore. C'mon, keep the
praise
coming!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And I'm definitely gonna win the next
one too, so
you better get more
compliments ready!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Obviously! ♪ Who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This is only the beginning. My win streak
started
the moment I set foot on the
track!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Get ready, 'cause I'm gonna go above
and
beyond even your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you what a real winner looks
like!
